text_block_list.text:
After shopping with Epiphaneia, we decided
to grab a bite before heading back and stepped
into a nearby restaurant, but—

Intimidated by the classy atmosphere inside, I hesitated a little.
It seems best to keep quiet here.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooh, beef Wellington! I loooove pastry dishes~!
choice_data_list: !? Epi, your voice is too loud...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But we came all this way,
it'd be a waste if we didn't enjoy ourselves!
choice_data_list: Still, there's a time and place for—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's order right away! Excuse me~! We'd like to order, pleaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What a noisy person.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It is just as that Trainer says.
Do be quiet, you."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
――! Gentildonna!
What a coincidence, you're here too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm so happy to run into you here!
Would you like to grab a bite together if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I told you to be quiet, didn't I?
Take a good look around you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Woman Seeking Advice
text_block_list.text: I know... I probably will never meet someone better than him. But—

text_block_list.name: Woman Seeking Advice
text_block_list.text:
"Throw away my career and relocate? I can't just
make that decision right away... What should I do!?"

text_block_list.name: Businessman in Negotiation
text_block_list.text:
—All of our employees have worked diligently every day
toward the success of this project...!

text_block_list.name: Businessman in Negotiation
text_block_list.text: So please, rest assured and leave this matter to me! I truly look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Someone's making a rather troubled face over there. What a waste during mealtime.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Meals are best enjoyed properly!
However...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I wonder why... somehow, this place feels—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? What this place provides is
not merely a way to satisfy one's desires.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —What the venue provides...?

text_block_list.name: Woman Beaming with Joy
text_block_list.text:
"Because we met at this very place that day,
we can...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah... This is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey!! —...Oops.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey. I think I might understand now.
Gentil... thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Those destined to meet connect, resonate—
and then branch out once more.
This is simply that kind of place—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —It's an "intersection of destinies"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: My Trainer told me before, too. To act according to the time, place, and occasion.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Places... have meaning.
They play an essential role in bringing destinies together.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me escort you again.
I'll get it right next time, I promise.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Giving thanks for your wonderful guidance—
and for the destiny that brought us together in this special place.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's have a meal together next time. I swear I'll dress appropriately for the place.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall hold high expectations, you know?
That you will make this a meaningful time for us.
choice_data_list: Let's cherish the fate that brought us to such a delicious meal.
Shall we propose a toast to everyone's destiny?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Heheh, yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It was destiny that brought us here today.
And finding this pot pie was fate too."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let us feast, Trainer.
While gazing upon this magnificent vista,
where all of our destinies intertwine—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Trainer.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil, come now, you too.
Let us raise our glasses together."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad the three of us could meet up like this.
Now, let's have the best time ever!"
